skills.title: Hybrid skill retrieval
skills.summary: Recall broadly, then filter for applicability before injecting a compact skill set.
instructions: Apply hard filters for tools, permissions, versions, preconditions, and explicit exclusions.
Combine lexical and semantic recall, then rerank candidates for applicability to the current state.
Inject only a small final set and log candidates, scores, ordering, and rejection reasons.

skills.title: Immutable rollout snapshot
skills.summary: All samples in one RL comparison group must read the same immutable skill snapshot.
instructions: Pin one snapshot before the group starts and record its ID in every trajectory.
Stage candidate writes without exposing them to any rollout in the current group.
Commit or reject candidates at a single deterministic barrier after group evaluation.

skills.title: Skill validation gate
skills.summary: Promote skill changes only when paired protected-task replay shows non-regression.
instructions: Keep task reward separate from reusable-skill utility and size, latency, redundancy, safety, and leakage costs.
Compare old and candidate snapshots on identical held-out probes, model weights, seeds, and budgets.
Version accepted changes; quarantine rejected candidates and preserve a deterministic commit journal.
